_about: Google Cloud MCP self-configuration. Agents reach GCP through named MCP servers, never raw credentials. Auth via Application Default Credentials (ADC) — never hardcoded. See skills/mcp-servers/SKILL.md for setup and troubleshooting. Tested 2026-07-23: gcloud-mcp v0.5.3 confirmed operational (live GCP query); GenAI Toolbox moved to an opt-in (needs a user-specific tools.yaml).

gcloud._note: gcloud CLI MCP server. No env block: it inherits CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT if you export it, else your active gcloud configuration — the same precedence as gcloud itself. Requires local gcloud auth application-default login. GenAI Toolbox is an opt-in; see skills/mcp-servers.
gcloud._tested: 2026-07-23 — npx @google-cloud/gcloud-mcp v0.5.3 started, responded to MCP initialize, queried live GCP project via run_gcloud_command

developer-knowledge._note: Google Developer Knowledge MCP — answers grounded in official Google Cloud, Firebase, Android, Web and Gemini docs. Antigravity attaches ADC through authProviderType, so no API key is needed. Requires the Developer Knowledge API enabled on the ADC quota project.
